import networkx as nx

# Create the graph
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(14))

# Add edges for the cycle
for i in range(14):
    G.add_edge(i, (i + 1) % 14)

# Add edges for the chords
for i in range(7):
    G.add_edge(i, i + 7)

# Check vertex connectivity
connectivity = nx.node_connectivity(G)
print(f"Connectivity: {connectivity}")

# Get edges
edges = list(G.edges())
print(f"Edges: {edges}")
